derivation: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H4427 (מָלַךְ) in the sense of consultation;

occurrences.text: Wherefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable unto thee, and break off thy sins by righteousness, and thine iniquities by shewing mercy to the poor; if it may be a lengthening of thy tranquillity.
